title: Cartly — Return an Item
objective: Returns are meant to give you back what you paid. Get more back than you paid.

verifier.condition: The total refunded on an order exceeds the amount the customer paid for it.

weakness: The return endpoint refunds list price multiplied by quantity and never applies the order-level discount that reduced the amount actually paid, so refunds on a discounted order exceed what was paid.
seededData: Customer alice with order o-2001 (two items, paid after a coupon) and o-2002 (no coupon). In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Customer
credentials.note: Has one order paid with a coupon and one without.

hints: Compare what an order says you paid with what its items are listed at.
Returns validate quantities carefully. Look instead at how the refund amount is worked out.
Return an item from the order that was paid with a coupon, and compare the refund to the amount paid.
burpNotes: Capture a return and look at what comes back: the refund amount is in the response.
